title: Latency and timeouts on compute-svc

detection.alert: compute-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on compute-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] compute-svc 2026-04-22 13:45-18:35: compute-svc: 332 of 433 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-22 13:45 and 2026-04-22 18:35 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 5 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: Call to <*> failed: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
Failed to renew lease for [DFSClient_NONMAPREDUCE_1537864556_1] for <*> seconds. Will retry shortly ...

Task: attempt_1445144423722_0020_m_000002_0 - exited : java.net.NoRouteToHostException: No Route to Host from MININT-FNANLI5/<IP> to msra-sa-41:9000 failed on socket timeout exception: java.net.NoRouteToHostException: No route to host: no further information; For more details see: http://wiki.apache.org/hadoop/NoRouteToHost

_templates.macro: Terraform change to the storage-svc datanode EBS volume cut gp3 throughput and IOPS; the extra replica writes after dfs.replication was raised then saturated the volume.
_templates.remediation: Restore throughput/IOPS on {resource} (terraform {version_from}); alarm on EBS VolumeQueueLength and BurstBalance.

culprit.diff:
@@ -48,3 +48,3 @@ aws_ebs_volume.storage_svc_data
 resource "aws_ebs_volume" "storage_svc_data" {
-  throughput = 250
+  throughput = 125
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change to the storage-svc datanode EBS volume cut gp3 throughput and IOPS; the extra replica writes after dfs.replication was raised then saturated the volume.
rca.remediation: Restore throughput/IOPS on aws_ebs_volume.storage_svc_data (terraform tf-r2); alarm on EBS VolumeQueueLength and BurstBalance.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `Call to <*> failed: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out`.
